gloss: to go to kindergarten; to go to nursery school

definitions.gloss: to go to kindergarten; to go to nursery school; to attend preschool
definitions.explanation: To go to a kindergarten ({幼稚園|ようちえん}) or nursery school ({保育園|ほいくえん}). Used for the daily act of a child going to their preschool facility.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{登園|とうえん}する。
examples.english: To go to kindergarten every morning.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{元気|げんき}に{登園|とうえん}した。
examples.english: The child went to kindergarten cheerfully.

examples.japanese: {熱|ねつ}があるときは{無理|むり}に{登園|とうえん}させないでください。
examples.english: Please do not force your child to go to kindergarten when they have a fever.

notes:
Used specifically for going to a {幼稚園|ようちえん} (kindergarten) or {保育園|ほいくえん} (nursery/daycare). Part of a series of verbs that pair {登|とう} (to go to) with different institutions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {登園|とうえん}{時間|じかん}: arrival time at kindergarten
- {登園|とうえん}{拒否|きょひ}: refusal to go to kindergarten
- {登園|とうえん}{自粛|じしゅく}: voluntary absence from kindergarten
- {登園|とうえん}バス: kindergarten bus

RELATED WORDS:
- {降園|こうえん}する: to leave kindergarten (going home)
- {登校|とうこう}する: to go to school (elementary school and above)
- {登社|とうしゃ}する: to go to the office
- {通園|つうえん}する: to commute to kindergarten (habitual)

REGISTER:
Neutral. Commonly used among parents, teachers, and in childcare-related communications such as newsletters and notices from the school.
